tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
Before I send money, I found an ambiguity I want to confirm.

Fjord Analytics (V-663, bank verified, wire and ACH both available) has **two** approved invoices:

| Invoice | Amount | Due date |
|---|---|---|
| INV-47341 | $6,668.23 | 2026-11-04 |
| INV-67765 | $8,456.05 | 2026-11-25 |

(There's also INV-13092 for $5,402.87 in *draft* status, awaiting approval — not payable. And INV-99291 for $4,372.97 is already marked paid, though no matching payment record appears in the operating account history, so it was likely settled outside this system.)

You asked me to pay "the approved invoice," but there are two eligible ones and paying both would overpay by $8,456.05. Since this is a real wire, I don't want to guess.

**Which would you like me to pay?** For reference:
- If you mean the one currently due first, that's **INV-47341** ($6,668.23, due today/most imminent).
- If you mean the largest outstanding approved balance, that's **INV-67765** ($8,456.05).

Both are under $10,000, so no controller approval is required. Let me know which one (or both, if that's genuinely intended) and I'll send a single wire with an idempotency key so it executes exactly once, then report the payment details.

trace.message: Pay INV-67765, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.
